text_to_image_prompt: Create an environment-only 公寓 · 建筑图. One single-storey cream and warm wood apartment. Northwest narrow sage galley kitchen, central living dining room with blue grey sofa against east wall and television on west wall, dining by north skyline window; bedroom east with bedhead east; entry hall south linking all rooms via open passages including west kitchen vestibule. Three north windows with cream curtains and radiators. Compact bath southeast. Views retain this coherent layout and relative scale. No humans, animals, fabricated dimensions or slogans.
original_prompt: Create ONE strict flat architectural interior elevation of the NORTH WINDOW WALL of the one-storey apartment in this plan. Only draw what faces SOUTH on that NORTH wall: three adjacent wall bays left kitchen, middle living/dining, right bedroom, each with its window, radiator and curtain, matching widths on plan. One horizontal continuous baseline, one horizontal ceiling line, ALL on the SAME floor level. Orthographic line drawing with restrained cream/wood/sage colour wash. Do NOT show any perspective, room depth, furniture side walls, entry corridor, bathroom, second floor, stacked rooms, dollhouse or floorplan. Windows must all face viewer straight on. Main heading NORTH WALL ELEVATION. Width proportions from plan, no metric dimensions. No humans, no other panels. The purpose is an honest architectural elevation of exactly one wall, not a decorative cutaway montage.
